purpose: Families to import into LeulAria/Aria-Icons: open-source SVG icon sets not already bundled (deduped by geometry + raster fingerprint against Aria, @iconify/json and each other).
how_to_use: Fetch each family as described in fetch; the exact SVG files that survived dedupe are listed (one path per line) in paths_file, relative to the fetched tree as described in fetch.instructions.

svg_subpaths/include_regex/exclude_regex describe the selection if you prefer a glob; selection_mode=theme means one icon per basename (scalable preferred) across size folders; flat means size variants collapsed to one master.
Keep each family's LICENSE/attribution; copyleft families (GPL/LGPL/CC-BY-SA/MPL/EPL) are flagged and may need to be shipped as separately licensed packs.
Round-1 path lists were reconstructed from geometry signatures and may differ slightly from new_unique where several files share a signature.
